about.title: About me
body: I'm a software developer from Girona, Spain. I work full-time at Asartec, building occupational health & safety (PRL) software with C#, VB.NET and SQL, and I study Computer Engineering part-time at UOC.
I'm an early adopter of new tech: I use Claude Code every day to generate, review and document code, and I've built skills, hooks and agents for our team.
I work best when I understand the logic behind a task. I'm a calm debugger and a cooperative teammate, happiest in small teams with autonomy and clear requirements.

items.title: asartec.net — company helpdesk
items.body: A custom helpdesk that became the company-wide ticketing system. First version in Node.js, later rebuilt in PHP.

items.title: From 10–20 s to under 1 s
items.body: The 'responsables' web app took 10–20 seconds to load. Diagnosing it with Claude Code, I found that logs written inside the app folder were triggering restarts. After the fix it loads in under a second.

items.title: Occupational risk-prevention software
items.body: I develop a VB.NET/C# Windows Forms PRL application, a C# API and .NET MAUI web/mobile apps used by universities and prevention services.

items.title: AI-assisted development
items.body: I automated parts of our workflow with Claude Code: code generation, code review and documentation, plus custom skills, hooks and agents.

items.title: DAM final project
items.body: Final project of my vocational degree in Multiplatform Application Development.

items.title: This portfolio
items.body: A 3D room built with Three.js and Vite, hosted on GitHub Pages, developed with Claude Code. Every object is a section.

items.title: Software Developer — Asartec
items.body: PRL desktop, API and .NET MAUI apps. Built the company helpdesk. I support the other junior developer on a team of 3.
